Prediabetes means your blood sugar levels are higher than normal, but not yet in the range of type 2 diabetes. It is an important opportunity to improve your health through sustainable changes in diet, physical activity, sleep and stress management.
In this video, Hansaji explains how to support healthy blood sugar levels with a practical 21-day diet and yoga plan.
You will learn five important dietary principles:
1. Increase fibre through vegetables, whole fruits, whole grains, millets, dals and beans.
